{{Quote|Dash-1044 isn't responding, Sir. Nor is Nin&mdash;I mean, Dash-1129.|A clone sergeant, to Plo Koon|<ref name="Dug Out" />}}
'''Dash-1129''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] and member of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] who fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. They served during a [[Mission to Malastare (Clone Wars)|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to investigate the Separatist's presence. While on the planet, Dash-1129 and fellow [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Four-Four|Dash-1044]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by primitive [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]]. Their dead bodies, hung in the [[Tree/Legends|trees]], were eventually spotted by Tano.

==Biography==
{{Quote|''Droids'' didn't do this. There's something ''else'' out here. On your guard.|Plo Koon upon seeing Dash-1129 and Dash-1044's dead bodies.|<ref name="Dug Out" />}}
[[File:SneakyDugs-DugOut.png|thumb|left|250px|The primitive Dugs sneak up on the unsuspecting troopers.]]
Dash-1129, who went by a nickname beginning with "Nin," was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Dug Out" /> They were created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from the [[Clone template/Legends|clone template]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="Databank" /> 

At some point between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] tracked several heavily-cloaked [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] to<ref name="Dug Out" /> the planet<ref name="TCW:TZB">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}}</ref> [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. Dash-1129 took part in a [[Mission to Malastare (Clone Wars)|mission]] to Malastare led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and<ref name="Dug Out" /> [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]]<ref name="Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to investigate the Separatists' presence on the planet. As the group approached the planet's surface aboard an [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]], they were shot out of the [[Atmosphere/Legends|sky]] by [[Confederacy military/Legends|Separatist forces]].<ref name="Dug Out" />

With everyone surviving the crash, Dash-1129 and the rest of the group set out to locate the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] encampment. As they got closer, a [[Unidentified clone trooper commander (Malastare)|clone commander]] ordered the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to spread out and surround the encampment. Unbeknownst to the group, they were being watched by primitive members of the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. While the group began to spread out, Dash-1129 and fellow [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] trooper [[Four-Four|Dash-1044]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Dugs and hung in the [[Tree/Legends|trees]]. After their deaths, their [[Unidentified clone trooper sergeant (Malastare)|clone sergeant]] attempted to contact them. Getting no response, the [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] informed Koon about the situation just as Tano spotted their bodies dangling from the trees. Realizing that it was not the work of droids, Koon ordered the rest of the [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to stay on guard.<ref name="Dug Out" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of Jango Fett,<ref name="Databank" /> Dash-1129 had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin<ref name="Skin" /> and a height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="Databank" /> They also had black [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="Dug Out" />

==Equipment==
Dash-1129 wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]].<ref name="Dug Out" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dash-1129 appeared in "[[Dug Out]]," a comic story published in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.19|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic'' 6.19]]. The story was written by [[Rik Hoskin]], illustrated by [[Will Sliney]], and published by [[Titan Magazines]]<ref name="Dug Out" /> on [[April 7]], [[2011]].<ref name="Parent release date">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/whatsnew_apr11/index.html|text=What's New This Week: ''Clone Wars Comic'' #6.19, ''Galaxy Comic'' #7, ''Invasion -- Rescues'' and ''The Clone Wars'' in 3-D}}</ref>
